8. 1. 11

Sigālasuttaṃ. 

393. Sāvatthiyaṃ-

Assuttha no tumhe bhikkhave, rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ sigālassa vassamānassāti?5 Evaṃ bhante. Eso kho bhikkhave, jarasigālo ukkaṇṭakena nāma rogajātena phuṭṭho. So yena yena icchati, tena tena gacchati. Yattha yattha icchati, tattha tattha tiṭṭhati. Yattha yattha icchati, tattha tattha nisīdati. Yattha yattha icchati, tattha tattha nipajjati. Sītako'pi naṃ vāto upavāyati. Sādhu khvassa bhikkhave, yaṃ idhekacco sakyaputtiyapaṭiñño evarūpampi attabhāvapaṭilābhaṃ paṭisaṃvedayetha. 

Tasmātiha bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ: ''appamattā viharissāmā''ti. Evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave, sikkhitabbanti.
